fold_rule: first eight SHA256 bytes of example_id modulo 4
bag_rule: score(action)=P(quality_repair)-P(quality_break); gate=max eligible action score; tie-break lowest sentence index
eligible_rule: candidate cumulative context tokens <= V8 baseline
primary_gate: At 5% or 10% budget, repair opportunities exceed same-pool random expectation in at least 3 of 4 folds, actual repairs exceed breaks, Complete does not decrease, and mean cumulative context tokens do not increase. 15% is descriptive.
